meta.purpose: single source of truth for the T03/T03b/T03c analytic models and the T04 simulation; derived section written by 03_simulation/compute_R01.py
meta.based_on: T03 stator: 48 slots, pitch 7, 3 turns/coil, R_gap 165 mm, L_stk 360 mm, R_out 235 mm, slot 9 x 45 mm, yoke 25 mm

winding.module_coil_rule: module j = coils j, j+16, j+32 (star, isolated neutral); coil k has sides in slots k (top layer) and k+7 (bottom layer)
winding.top_air_note: wedge 3.0 mm + clearance/cooling gap; non-magnetic wedge assumed

airgap.note: g_eff = g * k_c,s * k_c,r. NO saturation factor in g_eff: iron saturation is a separate flux-dependent curve (magnetising_curve in derived).

rotor_wrsm.rotor_yoke_rule: yoke thickness >= 2x the 8-pole value so the ++-- (2p=4) pattern stays below 1.6 T
rotor_wrsm.B0_note: no-load air-gap flux density at full field, kept from T03 so psi_f,max is unchanged

material.name: M270-35A-like generic
material.note: B-H is a generic M270-35A table (not a measured curve); loss anchors are catalogue points used by both models

limits.limits_note: design rules from T03/T03b; applied to the TRUE flux density (with stacking factor). T03 used B_gap<=0.90 T and B_yoke<=1.45 T without stacking factor.

notes: Copper: 6 hairpin-type conductors of 7.5 x 5.4 mm bare (40.5 mm2) per slot = the T03 turn area, so R_coil (2.155 mOhm at 120 C) and copper mass (62.9 kg, T03b constraint) are unchanged.
Slot fill 0.60 of the gross 9 x 45 mm slot (0.86 of the insulated window), current density 7.7 A/mm2 at 310 A and 6.6 A/mm2 at 266 A (oil-cooled, as T03).

Radial slot layout from the bottom: liner 0.5, bottom layer 17.7, separator 1.0, top layer 17.7, air/wedge 6.6, tooth tip 1.5 = 45 mm. The 6.6 mm above the conductors is not copper: it counts in slot leakage.
Teeth are parallel-slot (tapered): 12.6 mm at the bore, 18.5 mm at the root. B limit is checked at the tip; the iron MMF uses the width at one third of the height (14.6 mm).
Air gap 1.0 mm mechanical for the IM; k_c from stator and rotor slot openings; saturation is NOT in g_eff (T03 used k_c*k_sat = 1.3).
End winding: length 1.2*pi*D_mid*y/Q + 2*20 mm per side and lambda_end 0.3 are T03 values, not verified by this work.
Rotor cage: 58 rectangular bars 7.0 x 21.4 mm, 1 mm bridge, copper rings 600 mm2 at 270 mm mean diameter (T03/T03b values; the bar shape is new but its area is unchanged).

WRSM rotor: 8 salient poles, 50 mm pole body, 55 mm deep interpolar slots, shaft radius 40 mm; the air gap and field winding are set in the derived section (compute_R01.py), because the IM gap does not give a physical WRSM.
